views.name: player_dim
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_id,
  player_name,
  dob,
  batting_hand,
  bowling_skill,
  country_name
FROM player
views.description: Normalized player dimension: canonicalizes players for reporting. Use when joining player attributes (name, country, batting/bowling style) onto event or match data. | Use for: player profiles and demographics; filter players by country or batting/bowling style; join player attributes to ball-by-ball or match-level analyses

views.name: team_dim
views.description: Normalized team dimension: one row per team. Use when joining team names to matches or aggregations. | Use for: match lists per team; team-level win/loss aggregations; labeling team ids in result sets

views.name: match_dim
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  match_id,
  team_1,
  team_2,
  match_date,
  season_id,
  venue,
  toss_winner,
  toss_decision,
  win_type,
  win_margin,
  outcome_type,
  match_winner,
  man_of_the_match
FROM "match"
views.description: Normalized match dimension: one row per match with core attributes preserved for joins (teams, date, venue, outcome fields). Use as the canonical match record. | Use for: match-level summaries; filter matches by season/date/venue; join match details to events or player participations

views.name: player_match_participation
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  match_id,
  player_id,
  role,
  team_id
FROM player_match
views.description: One row per player-match participation with role and team assignment. Useful for linking players to matches and teams (e.g., who played, captains). | Use for: which players appeared in a match; identify captains or specific roles in matches; aggregate player counts per team or match

views.name: ball_events
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.over_id,
  b.ball_id,
  b.team_batting,
  b.team_bowling,
  b.striker_batting_position,
  b.striker,
  b.non_striker,
  b.bowler,
  COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) AS runs_scored,
  COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0) AS extra_runs,
  (COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) AS total_runs_on_ball
FROM ball_by_ball b
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
  ON b.match_id = bs.match_id
  AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
  AND b.over_id = bs.over_id
  AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
LEFT JOIN extra_runs er
  ON b.match_id = er.match_id
  AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
  AND b.over_id = er.over_id
  AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id
views.description: Denormalized ball-level events: joins ball_by_ball with batsman_scored and extra_runs to present total runs per ball along with players involved. Use for per-ball analysis and to compute aggregated batting/bowling metrics. | Use for: per-ball run distributions; aggregate runs by batsman or bowler; identify balls with extras or wickets (join further with wicket_taken)

views.name: wickets_events
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  w.match_id,
  w.innings_no,
  w.over_id,
  w.ball_id,
  w.player_out,
  w.kind_out,
  b.team_batting,
  b.team_bowling,
  b.striker,
  b.non_striker,
  b.bowler
FROM wicket_taken w
LEFT JOIN ball_by_ball b
  ON w.match_id = b.match_id
  AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no
  AND w.over_id = b.over_id
  AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id
views.description: Wicket events at ball-grain joined to ball_by_ball to include contextual bowling and batting positions. Useful for analyzing dismissals with batter/bowler context. | Use for: who got out and how (kind_out) by bowler or venue; per-over wicket rates; link dismissal events to player profiles

views.name: runs_by_batsman_per_match
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  bs_match.match_id,
  bs_match.innings_no,
  b.striker AS player_id,
  SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) AS total_batsman_runs
FROM ball_by_ball b
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
  ON b.match_id = bs.match_id
  AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
  AND b.over_id = bs.over_id
  AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id FROM batsman_scored
) bs_match
  ON b.match_id = bs_match.match_id
  AND b.innings_no = bs_match.innings_no
  AND b.over_id = bs_match.over_id
  AND b.ball_id = bs_match.ball_id
GROUP BY
  bs_match.match_id,
  bs_match.innings_no,
  b.striker
views.description: Aggregated runs by batsman per match: sums runs_scored (batsman-only) and exposes innings and match identifiers. Use for batting scorecards per match. | Use for: match scorecards for batsmen; top scorers per match or innings; combine with player_dim to show names

views.name: bowler_deliveries_and_runs
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.bowler AS player_id,
  COUNT(1) AS deliveries_bowled,
  SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) AS runs_conceded
FROM ball_by_ball b
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
  ON b.match_id = bs.match_id
  AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
  AND b.over_id = bs.over_id
  AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
LEFT JOIN extra_runs er
  ON b.match_id = er.match_id
  AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
  AND b.over_id = er.over_id
  AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id
GROUP BY
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.bowler
views.description: Aggregated deliveries and runs conceded per bowler per match and innings. Counts balls bowled (deliveries) and sums total_runs_on_ball (including extras) when available. Use for bowling analyses and economy rates. | Use for: bowling economy and wicket-to-ball rates per match; aggregate bowler workload per innings or match; compare bowlers across matches or seasons

views.name: player_latest_match_role_rank
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.match_id,
  pm.player_id,
  pm.role,
  pm.team_id,
  m.match_date,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pm.player_id ORDER BY m.match_date DESC, pm.match_id DESC) AS rank_per_player
FROM player_match pm
LEFT JOIN "match" m
  ON pm.match_id = m.match_id
views.description: Ranks player appearances by match_date per player to identify the most recent matches and roles. Exposes a rank_per_player so downstream queries can pick latest N per player via rank_per_player <= K. | Use for: latest match(s) per player; career progression and recent roles; filter for recent participation to join with performance

views.name: match_running_total_runs
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  eb.match_id,
  eb.innings_no,
  eb.over_id,
  eb.ball_id,
  eb.total_runs_on_ball,
  SUM(eb.total_runs_on_ball) OVER (PARTITION BY eb.match_id, eb.innings_no ORDER BY eb.over_id, eb.ball_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_runs
FROM (
  SELECT
    b.match_id,
    b.innings_no,
    b.over_id,
    b.ball_id,
    COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0) AS total_runs_on_ball
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
    ON b.match_id = bs.match_id
    AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    AND b.over_id = bs.over_id
    AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
  LEFT JOIN extra_runs er
    ON b.match_id = er.match_id
    AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
    AND b.over_id = er.over_id
    AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id
) eb
views.description: Running cumulative total runs by innings within each match (ordered by over_id, ball_id). Uses total_runs_on_ball (batsman + extras). Exposes running_total_runs to support per-over progression charts. | Use for: score progression per innings or match; compute run rates by over using running totals; charting cumulative runs over time within an innings
